title: Who the Anarchs Are
summary: The young rebels of the Camarilla, as the movement sees itself.

claims.text: Most anarchs are neonates who still identify closely with their mortal peers.
Their ranks fill with bikers, punks, goths, young philosophy students, street gangsters, skaters and similar rebels.
Princes and justicars who answer anarchs with harsh reprisal only swell the movement by giving it something to rebel against.

title: Primogen and Anarchs
summary: How the strength of a primogen council shapes a city.

claims.text: Some newer American towns have a prince but no primogen, being small enough to hold few vampires and little rebellion.
A strong prince who rules fairly usually dominates the council; where a prince works against the other clans, the primogen may be strong enough to push back.

title: When an Anarch Revolt Fails
summary: What usually follows a failed rising.

claims.text: Most of the time the prince wins, and the anarchs slip back to the outskirts and lie low.
Captured anarchs face the prince, or a justicar if their crimes broke the Masquerade.
After a defeat an anarch's best hope is usually to flee the city.

title: Salvador Garcia
summary: A Brujah anarch known among the Kindred.

claims.text: Salvador Garcia is a Brujah, sired by Ferdinand and Embraced in 1892, who looks about 23.
Both sides have accused Garcia of working for the other rather than for the anarchs.
